messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: p99 latency > 2.5s for /v1/generate across multiple regions; SLO breach detected. auto-page to #incidents.

maria (oncall-sre): I'm on it. Seeing errors in traces: long auth.ms and several 502s from control-plane -> inference nodes timing out. Paging DB and runtime.

sanjay (runtime): Confirmed. p95 up from 120ms to 900ms; p99 hitting 3.2s. Streaming stalls visible (clients stuck waiting for first token). Logs show many auth:config_fetch calls blocked.

elaine (db): I'm looking at auth-db. Connection pool is saturated, many queries waiting on pg_backend. Top query is: "SELECT token FROM service_tokens WHERE id=$1 FOR UPDATE" — long lock times.

chris (prod-ml): Impact: streaming tails lead to timeouts at customers using streaming endpoints. We've got a few customer-reported errors (500/timeout). CS looped in.

david (customer-success): I'm getting inbound from 2 enterprise customers about delayed responses. Quotas look normal, they say liveness failures.

maria (oncall-sre): Quick triage: is this a deployment? any recent feature flags touching auth/cache?

sanjay (runtime): We rolled feature-flags v3 last night that enabled per-request config fetch for experiments. Could be flood on control-plane.

mike (eng-lead): If config fetch is now per-request, DB load could spike. Recommend immediate mitigation: flip the per-request flag off to fall back to cached config, and add short-term auth caching in runtime.

sanjay (runtime): Rolling rollback of flag now. Command:
```bash
curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN" https://flags.internal/flags/per-request-config -d '{"state":"off"}'
```

sanjay (runtime): Done. Flag changed at 1782345740. Pushing a public comment: disabling per-request config.

incident-bot: Deploy event: feature-flag updated by sanjay at 1782345740.

elaine (db): After flag flip I see inflight queries dropping. Pool usage down from 98% to 45% within 30s. Latency improving.

maria (oncall-sre): Good. Can we also add a temporary cache for auth tokens in runtime for 10s to reduce token lookups? low risk.

sanjay (runtime): Adding in-process 10s TTL cache and will ship a hotfix to all runtime pods. Rolling patch now (canary first).

ops-bot: Canary rollout started: runtime-hotfix v2.3 -> 5 pods.

sanjay (runtime): Canary healthy. Prometheus shows p99 dropping to ~700ms for canary region.

maria (oncall-sre): Gradual rollback of flag + hotfix seems to be working. Monitoring p95/p99 over next 15m. Marking Sev2 for now; no data loss, reduced degradation.

david (customer-success): Notifying the two customers: "We've applied a mitigation; you may see improved response times in a few minutes. We'll follow up with RCA." Sending now.

mike (eng-lead): DB team, should we consider increasing pool size or adding read replicas for auth-db longer term?

elaine (db): Short-term we can increase max_connections and tune slow queries, but root cause is the per-request config change. Postmortem should include feature flag gating and load-tests.

chris (prod-ml): Also track streaming-specific SLOs separately; streaming stalls cause more customer-visible pain. We'll add a regression test suite for streaming latency when feature flags change.

maria (oncall-sre): On-call handoff: I'm patching and will stay until metrics stable. If anyone needs to escalate, page me. Next oncall at 1782349000 will take over and I'll brief them.

incident-bot: Pager duty note: handoff at 1782349000 scheduled for oncall rotation.

ops-bot: All runtime pods now running hotfix v2.3; rollout complete.

sanjay (runtime): p99 across regions now ~420ms, p95 ~120ms. Streaming stalls cleared in traces.

maria (oncall-sre): Closing mitigation loop. Action items: 1) Postmortem with timeline and root cause, 2) Add flag rollback autosafe for heavy-control-plane operations, 3) Add auth token short TTL cache by default, 4) Load test per-request config path. Owners: chris/sanjay/elaine.

david (customer-success): I'll follow up with customers with ETA for RCA.

maria (oncall-sre): Thanks all. Moving to investigation channel for RCA drafts. If metrics regress, re-open.

ops-bot: Incident status -> mitigated. Logged at 1782345949.

maria (oncall-sre): Final note: severity downgraded to S3 at 1782345950. Will create incident doc.
